thread:
Maya (design): Quick design notes after testing tool-calling output in the playground: main pain is long JSON blobs cluttering run history.
Omar (devex): Short list pls.
Maya (design): 1) Show a compact row with up to 3 "chips" for key:value snippets, 2) clicking a chip opens a right flyout with full structured output + run metadata, 3) replace 'Expand JSON' label with 'Show structured output'.
Priya (eng): Sounds doable. For chip rendering we can cap values at 40 chars and add a title hover with full text.
Alex (a11y): Chips need role="button" and visible focus outline. Flyout must receive focus on open and announce "Run details opened" via aria-live. Copy button tooltip should be "Copy output as JSON".
Maya (design): Also, replace stray 'Invoke' in the run history toolbar with 'Run' for consistency.
Omar (devex): Can we make compact the default for new users and add a prefs toggle to default to raw? We should track expand, copy clicks, and pref changes.
Priya (eng): I'll add a feature flag and telemetry keys: playground.output_view, playground.expand_click, playground.copy_json. Will include unit tests for focus retention.
devex-bot: PR created by priya: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/452
Alex (a11y): One more keyboard nit: pressing E while a row is focused toggles flyout. Also ensure aria-controls references the flyout ID.
Maya (design): I'll post a small mock and copy diffs in Figma comments. Thanks team.
Omar (devex): Assign owners: Priya (impl), Alex (a11y review), Maya (copy + mocks). We'll check metrics next sprint.
